g.text: SIH 2026 · TECHNICAL DECK / COMPETITIVE ARCHITECTURAL BENCHMARK
COMPETITIVE LANDSCAPE: TRADITIONAL & COMMERCIAL SENSING VS OCULA
Verified empirical cost and capability comparison against commercial, regulatory, and published academic architectures (sourced data, non-evaluative scoring).
Logarithmic scale (Base 10) · Hardware capital cost per deployed node in INR (₹)
OcuLA does not claim to be the absolute cheapest node; it sits in the identical sub-₹5,000 order of magnitude
as published academic prototypes (₹4,000 vs ₹3,800), while delivering multi-hazard detection, offline operation,
and hardware tamper-evidence absent in low-cost peers.
Verified architectural features across deployment tiers (binary verification + roadmap tracking)

text.tspan: Autonomous sensing and alerting with zero cloud
[1] CPCB / Karnataka SPCB public tender for CAAQMS station, Mysuru (Deccan Herald; typical CAAQMS unit cost ₹1.5–1.75 Cr). [2] Kaiterra Sensedge enterprise list price
($1,290–$1,490 list + Indian customs duty & GST, kaiterra.com). [3] PurpleAir PA-II retail import pricing ($279 USD list + shipping & import duties, purpleair.com). [4] Published peer-reviewed
ESP32+LoRa IoT environmental nodes (IEEE Sensors Journal / MDPI Sensors, prototype hardware BOM ~₹3,800). [5] OcuLA engineering hardware bill-of-materials (ESP32-S3, multi-sensor cluster,
OLED, buzzer, solar charge controller; bench-tested prototype; field-pilot network is on development roadmap).
